[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] '''Daysaifor''' was an individual, who lived during the [[Third Atrisian period]]. Daysaifor's tacitical insights would later influence [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rom Mohc]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
